entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer service. How may I assist you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return something. It's a VeloBand Pulse. I bought it a little over two weeks ago.
Okay, I can help with that. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
It's [customer email address]. And hurry up, I don't have all day.
Thank you. One moment while I pull up your order. Okay, I see your purchase of the VeloBand Pulse on [Date of purchase]. I also see that it was delivered to you on [Date of Delivery].
Yeah, so? I want to return it. It doesn't work how I expected.
I understand. Our standard return window for the VeloBand Pulse, as per our policy, is 10 days from the date of delivery. According to my system, it has been 15 days since your delivery date.
What?! Are you serious? 10 days? That's ridiculous! I barely had time to even try it out. This is completely unfair!

I understand your frustration. While a full refund isn't possible due to being outside the return window, I can offer you a store credit for the full purchase amount. This will allow you to purchase another item from VeloFit that better suits your needs.

A store credit? Seriously? I wanted my money back! I don't want anything else from VeloFit if this is how you treat customers. I mean, come on! I thought this VeloBand Pulse was supposed to be great, but it's useless to me!

I apologize for the inconvenience. I know it's not ideal. Unfortunately, I am unable to offer a refund outside of the return window, but I can check if a policy exception can be made in this situation. One moment please.

(After a short hold) Thank you for your patience. I've reviewed your account and while a full refund is still not possible, I am authorized to provide a one-time 20% discount on your next VeloFit purchase in addition to the store credit. This will give you extra flexibility to choose something you truly love.
Okay, 20% off *and* the store credit? Well... I guess that's better than nothing. I was really counting on getting that money back, but fine. What's the store credit for exactly?

The store credit will be for the full amount you paid for the VeloBand Pulse, and the 20% discount code will be emailed to you within 24 hours and can be used on any item on our site. Both the store credit and discount code will be valid for one year. Will that work for you?
Alright, fine. That's... actually pretty good. Yeah, that works. Thank you.
Great! I'm glad we could find a solution. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's it. Thanks again, I appreciate you looking into that for me.
You're very welcome. We appreciate your business with VeloFit. Have a great day!
